training: Task-specific directed-bond graph, fingerprint and hybrid heads; MAE with 5 percent smooth L1; no pretrained weights. CatBoost MAE trained on the identical outer fitting rows is a reproducible comparator.
stopping: Inner scaffold groups of outer fitting data only; outer evaluation labels never stop training. Refit all outer fitting rows for the inner-selected epoch or tree count.
selection: Select expert and structure mixture using folds 0 and 1 against same-fold MAE tree comparator. Freeze before fold 2 and official valid. Historical arrays are proxy diagnostics only and do not constitute exact full v73 OOF.
limitations: All development labels were used historically. Held partitions separate decisions within this experiment but are not new independent data. Full historical anchor weights are incomplete; no claim of exact v73 OOF. Official score remains unknown.
